title: Basic Counter Billing: Fast Search & Auto-FEFO

intro.title: Basic Counter Billing & Auto-FEFO
intro.subtitle: High-speed medicine lookup, automated batch picking, and instant checkout

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 1: POS Counter Mastery. At a busy pharmacy counter, speed is essential. Press F2 anytime to clear the counter and initialize a fresh customer bill.
narration.caption: Press F2 to clear counter and initialize a fresh customer bill.

narration.text: Press F3 or forward slash to jump straight to the search bar. MediFlow searches Brand Names, Generic Molecules, and Barcodes simultaneously without needing a mouse.
narration.caption: Press F3 or / to search brand names, molecules, and barcodes instantly.

narration.text: Notice the Auto-FEFO recommendation. MediFlow automatically prioritizes the earliest expiring batch in your racks, protecting your store from dead stock and shelf expiry loss.
narration.caption: Auto-FEFO automatically picks the earliest expiring batch in your racks.

narration.text: Press Enter to add the medicine to your active cart. The bill updates instantly with pack quantity, loose tablets, MRP, GST rates, and live net payable.
narration.caption: Instant cart insertion with pack quantity, MRP, GST breakdown, and net total.

narration.text: To finalize the sale, simply press F10. MediFlow generates the GST tax invoice, deducts inventory, and opens the thermal print receipt. Watch Part 2 for Barcode Scanning.
narration.caption: Press F10 to complete sale, deduct stock, and print thermal receipt.

outro.takeaway: Auto-FEFO Rule: Always dispense the earliest expiring batch first to prevent shelf expiration loss.
